name: kettlebell floor fly
description: Lie on the floor and open your arms out with kettlebells, stopping when your elbows touch down. It trains the chest.
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower your arms out to the sides until the elbows touch the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the weights back up.
